facts.summary: Adjunct therapy showed no meaningful benefit, AD program discontinued · Phase 3 · oral difelikefalin in atopic dermatitis pruritus · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Oral difelikefalin as adjunct to TCS did not demonstrate a meaningful clinical benefit compared to TCS alone, resulting in the Company’s decision to discontinue its clinical program in pruritus associated with atopic dermatitis.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Oral difelikefalin as adjunct therapy to TCS did not demonstrate a meaningful clinical benefit compared to TCS alone.
evidence.safety: Oral difelikefalin was generally well tolerated with a safety profile similar to prior trials.
evidence.program_discontinued: resulting in the Company’s decision to discontinue its clinical program in pruritus associated with atopic dermatitis.
